data.title: 早露 · 音乐会节目单
data.description: 演出还没开始，早露先把节目单从头读到尾。看到熟悉的曲目时，她轻声念了一遍名字。
data.camera: 中景，节目单和门厅背景可见
data.promptProse: Standing in a refined, high-ceilinged theater foyer, Rosa holds a glossy concert program in her hands, her eyes tracing the schedule with refined interest. Gilded wall sconces cast a sophisticated, warm light across her formal attire, with marble columns, red velvet carpets, and the anticipation of the upcoming performance reflected in the grand hall's elegant architecture.
